Change Trigger (User Story V1 → V2): US-01 (Safe Add): V1: int addition may overflow/wrap. → V2: clamp to Integer.MIN/MAX.
US-02 (Sub/Mul Consistency): V1: inconsistent arithmetic behavior. → V2: standardized delegation via ArithmeticUtils.
US-03 (Division): V1: division may mishandle zero / wrong delegation. → V2: strict divide-by-zero checks and correct delegation.
US-04 (Log Domain): V1: log allows non-positive values or bypasses validation. → V2: reject v<=0 and enforce LogUtils usage in services.
US-05 (Sqrt Domain Reuse): V1: negative sqrt yields NaN; callers may bypass RootFinder. → V2: RootFinder throws for v<0 and callers reuse it.
US-06 (Vector Norm): V1: null vectors may crash; norm not integrated with normalization. → V2: validate null and provide normalizedNorm with clamping.
US-07 (Mean): V1: empty input returns incorrect default or wrong denominator. → V2: return NaN for null/empty and correct divisor.
US-08 (Variance): V1: population variance and weak preconditions. → V2: sample variance (n-1) and require length>=2.
US-09 (Z-Score): V1: zScore uses variance as std-dev or unstable for small samples. → V2: compute std via sqrt(var) and enforce preconditions.
US-10 (Matrix Add): V1: assumes matching shapes and non-null inputs. → V2: validate null/empty and exact dimension match.
US-11 (Matrix Mul): V1: incorrect loop bounds / weak dimension checks. → V2: validate shapes and correct loop bounds.
US-12 (Matrix Workflows): V1: independent operations. → V2: composed operations (multiplyAndAdd, Frobenius norm) with shared validation.
US-13 (Number Theory): V1: fragmented utilities. → V2: NumberTheoryService provides coprime, fibGcd, safeLcm on shared primitives.
US-14 (Random Bound Validation): V1: nextInt called with invalid bounds causing runtime errors. → V2: validate bound>0 before generation.
US-15 (Facade Delegation): V1: facade delegates to wrong subsystem. → V2: stable delegation to correct service APIs.
